scope: integration audit on existing W(2,1000,1000) data; not independent validation or method ranking

protocol.units: original raw time units; no parameter-informed preprocessing
protocol.acceptance: original method success plus finite beta,eta>0 and gamma>=0; gamma<=min allowed only because DMMLE defines equality; no clipping
protocol.pairwise_reference: LRE, chosen before run because it has all archived samples valid
protocol.metrics: e_beta=(beta_hat-2)/2,e_eta=(eta_hat-1000)/1000,e_gamma=(gamma_hat-1000)/1000; paired common-valid sets only; q01 relative RMSE
protocol.SAM: absolute increment 1e-5, initial adjustment only; subsequent domain failure recorded
protocol.WMLE_recovered: archived successes plus three previously independently verified roots; recovery file SHA and original payload identity checked
protocol.DMMLE: raw alpha,sigma, start(1,1),20 iterations; original observed-information score
protocol.DMMLE_budget200: diagnostic follow-up after all 20-step runs failed residual gate; same score, start, units, stopping tolerance; increase maximum to 200; no accuracy-based selection
